systems.owner: Ministry of Health, national non-communicable disease programme, with WHO technical support
systems.tiers: pilot sites in several health structures; extension to four health districts planned by September 2026 and national generalisation in 2027

note: The system described is a patient-level tracker for one programme (hypertension and diabetes), a noted class that gives no fact; the national DHIS2 into which its data is to be integrated is named without any description of what it reports.
